ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) field comprising approximately 80% of surface area, with high-intensity (white) patches on distal lobes comprising approximately 20%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottled clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes. The right lobe contains a dense white patch with a singular dark circular pixel void at the upper lateral quadrant. The left lobe exhibits a more fragmented, speckled white distribution extending from the tip toward the midline.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45-50 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, with several larger U-shaped indentations on the medial right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral S-curve; lobes exhibit initial convexity from the notch before transitioning to a concave sweep towards the upward-tilted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of raised, textured, roughly circular high-contrast pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme lateral edges and tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the lower quadrant of the left lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant encrustation of barnacle colonies on the distal tips, creating a protruding, irregular peripheral boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark circular pigment spot (hole) centered within the white patch of the distal right lobe tip.
